verdict.rationale: The Radar API is a programmatic product, so API versioning and deprecation policy is a fair question here. The only hint of versioning in the pack is the "/v1" prefix in endpoint paths such as POST /v1/reviews/:id/approve. Nothing documents a versioning scheme, version pinning, changelogs or a deprecation policy, so the story's core requirement is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
